title: Leading only an Estimate does not turn Technician on
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in to production (the live app, app.shopview.com) as an Admin of the production test account, at its test location, Trucks Hill 2.
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have a new staff member for this test on production, staff member A, active, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on, Billable set to No, enrolled at Trucks Hill 2, whose only work is leading one service work order in Estimate, with no time recorded on it (written down with a screenshot of the staff record).
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings, Staff.
  2. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  3. Open Work Orders, Board View, at Trucks Hill 2.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Staff member A's row shows "No" in the Technician column.

Step 2:

  • Technician is off.

Step 3:

  • Staff member A has no column.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11880 (Story 2, Warning before turning Technician off), story SV-11884 (Story 6, Release day)

  • S6-E2: “Estimates, declined work orders, declined lines and part sales do not count toward S6-R1 (b).”
  • S6-R1 (b): “(b) leads, has labor on, or is on a line that is not declined (with labor on it, added with Add Technician or through a schedule shift, or as the line's own technician) of, a service work order that is Approved, In Progress or Ready for Review;”
  • Terminology: “Open work → in the turn-off warning, a service work order in Estimate, Approved, In Progress or Ready for Review that the person leads, or a line of such a work order that is not declined and that they are on (with labor on it, added with Add Technician or through a schedule shift, or as the line's own technician). On release day, only Approved, In Progress and Ready for Review count (Story 6).”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs the before values taken on production shortly before the release reaches production; run on production after the release
